label: ck-kpis/outcomes
sql:
SELECT
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed,
  countIf(at >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS closed_prev,
  countIf(at < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND outcome = 'resolved') AS resolved_prev
FROM (SELECT trace_id,
    min(row_at) AS at, argMax(r.outcome, toUInt64(r.sent) * 9223372036854775808 + toUInt64(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(r.row_at)) * 1048576 + cityHash64(r.outcome) % 1048576) AS outcome
  FROM (
    SELECT e.TraceId AS trace_id, t.OccurredAt AS row_at, e.Label AS outcome,
      0 AS sent
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, OccurredAt
      FROM trace_metrics
      WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    ) AS t
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT TraceId, Label
      FROM evaluation_metrics
      WHERE evaluation_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}))
        AND EvaluatorName = 'Conversation Outcome Judge'
        AND Label != '')
    ) AS e ON e.TraceId = t.TraceId
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TraceId AS trace_id, OccurredAt AS row_at, MetadataOutcome AS outcome,
      1 AS sent
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND MetadataOutcome != '')
  ) AS r
  GROUP BY trace_id)

WITH greatest(
  (SELECT toDateTime(max(CreatedAt)) FROM prompt_versions WHERE CreatedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND CreatedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}),
  (SELECT toDateTime(max(first_seen)) FROM (SELECT Model, min(BucketStart) AS first_seen
  FROM model_usage_by_minute
  WHERE BucketStart >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 30)
    AND BucketStart < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Model != ''
  GROUP BY Model
  HAVING first_seen >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
    AND first_seen >= addDays((SELECT min(BucketStart) FROM model_usage_by_minute
      WHERE BucketStart >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 30)
    AND BucketStart < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Model != ''), 1)))) AS changed_at,
  least(addDays(changed_at, 7), {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}) AS after_end,
  subtractDays(changed_at, 7) AS before_start,
  subtractDays(after_end, 7) AS before_end
SELECT OccurredAt >= changed_at AND OccurredAt < after_end AS after,
  count() AS traces,
  countIf(HasError) / count() AS error_rate,
  quantileExact(0.95)(TotalDurationMs) AS p95_ms,
  sum(TotalCost) / count() AS cost_per_trace
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( changed_at > toDateTime(0)
  AND (OccurredAt >= changed_at AND OccurredAt < after_end OR OccurredAt >= before_start AND OccurredAt < before_end))

sql:
WITH greatest(
  (SELECT toDateTime(max(CreatedAt)) FROM prompt_versions WHERE CreatedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND CreatedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}),
  (SELECT toDateTime(max(first_seen)) FROM (SELECT Model, min(BucketStart) AS first_seen
  FROM model_usage_by_minute
  WHERE BucketStart >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 30)
    AND BucketStart < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Model != ''
  GROUP BY Model
  HAVING first_seen >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}
    AND first_seen >= addDays((SELECT min(BucketStart) FROM model_usage_by_minute
      WHERE BucketStart >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 30)
    AND BucketStart < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND Model != ''), 1)))) AS changed_at,
  least(addDays(changed_at, 7), {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}) AS after_end,
  subtractDays(changed_at, 7) AS before_start,
  subtractDays(after_end, 7) AS before_end
SELECT sum(before_passed) / nullIf(sum(before_judged), 0) AS before_rate,
  sum(after_passed) / nullIf(sum(after_judged), 0) AS after_rate,
  sumIf(before_judged * after_passed / after_judged, after_judged > 0)
    / nullIf(sumIf(before_judged, after_judged > 0), 0) AS after_even_rate,
  sum(before_judged) AS before_checks,
  sum(after_judged) AS after_checks
FROM (
  SELECT ifNull(t.TopicId, '') AS topic,
    countIf(t.OccurredAt >= before_start AND t.OccurredAt < before_end AND e.Passed = 1) AS before_passed,
    countIf(t.OccurredAt >= before_start AND t.OccurredAt < before_end) AS before_judged,
    countIf(t.OccurredAt >= changed_at AND t.OccurredAt < after_end AND e.Passed = 1) AS after_passed,
    countIf(t.OccurredAt >= changed_at AND t.OccurredAt < after_end) AS after_judged
  FROM evaluation_metrics AS e
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, TopicId, OccurredAt
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= changed_at AND OccurredAt < after_end OR OccurredAt >= before_start AND OccurredAt < before_end)
  ) AS t ON t.TraceId = e.TraceId
  WHERE e.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( changed_at > toDateTime(0)
    AND e.Passed IS NOT NULL
    AND e.OccurredAt >= before_start)
  GROUP BY topic
)

sql:
SELECT
  sum(cost) AS spend,
  countIf(failed) AS failed_traces,
  sumIf(cost, failed) AS failed_cost,
  countIf(NOT failed AND repeats > 0) AS loop_traces,
  sumIf(cost * repeats / greatest(spans, 1), NOT failed AND repeats > 0) AS loop_cost,
  countIf(NOT failed AND repeats = 0 AND retries > 0) AS retry_traces,
  sumIf(retries * llm_cost / greatest(llm_ok, 1), NOT failed AND repeats = 0 AND retries > 0)
    AS retry_cost
FROM (SELECT ifNull(s.failed, 0) = 1 AS failed, t.cost AS cost,
    ifNull(s.spans, 0) AS spans, ifNull(s.retries, 0) AS retries,
    ifNull(s.repeats, 0) AS repeats, ifNull(s.llm_cost, 0) AS llm_cost, ifNull(s.llm_ok, 0) AS llm_ok
  FROM (
    SELECT TraceId, TotalCost AS cost
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  ) AS t
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, max(root_failed) AS failed, sum(calls) AS spans, sum(errored_llm) AS retries,
      sumIf(calls - 1, is_tool AND calls >= 3) AS repeats,
      sum(ok_llm_cost) AS llm_cost, sum(ok_llm) AS llm_ok
    FROM (
      SELECT TraceId, SpanName,
        SpanType = 'tool' AS is_tool,
        count() AS calls,
        max(ifNull(ParentSpanId, '') = '' AND StatusCode = 2) AS root_failed,
        countIf(StatusCode = 2 AND SpanType = 'llm') AS errored_llm,
        countIf(StatusCode != 2 AND SpanType = 'llm') AS ok_llm,

  sumIf(ifNull(p.share, 0) * j.passed / j.judged, j.judged > 0)
    / nullIf(sumIf(ifNull(p.share, 0), j.judged > 0), 0) AS weighted_rate,
  sum(j.judged) AS judged
FROM experiment_run_results AS x
INNER JOIN (SELECT e.RunId AS run_id, ifNull(m.TopicId, '') AS topic,
    countIf(e.Passed = 1) AS passed, count() AS judged
  FROM experiment_items AS e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT RunId, RowIndex, TargetId, any(TraceId) AS trace_id
    FROM experiment_items
    WHERE OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime} AND ResultType = 'target'
    GROUP BY RunId, RowIndex, TargetId

  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, TopicId FROM trace_metrics WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 1))

  FROM trace_metrics

  sum(failures) AS failures,
  sum(recovered) AS recovered
FROM (
  SELECT SpanName AS step, count() AS calls, countIf(StatusCode = 2) AS failures, 0 AS recovered
  FROM span_metrics
  WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND SpanType = 'tool'
    AND (ifNull(ParentSpanId, '') != ''
      OR (ParentSpanId IS NULL
        AND sipHash128(TraceId, SpanId) NOT IN (
          SELECT sipHash128(TraceId, ifNull(ParentSpanId, ''))
          FROM span_metrics
          WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
            AND ParentSpanId IS NOT NULL)
        ))))
  GROUP BY step
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.step AS step, 0 AS calls, 0 AS failures, count() AS recovered
  FROM span_metrics AS p
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT TraceId, ifNull(ParentSpanId, '') AS parent, SpanName AS step
    FROM span_metrics
    WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
      AND SpanType = 'tool'
      AND ifNull(ParentSpanId, '') != ''
      AND StatusCode = 2)
  ) AS c ON c.TraceId = p.TraceId AND c.parent = p.SpanId
  WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (p.TenantId, p.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (p.TenantId, p.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( p.StartTime >= subtractDays({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, 1) AND p.StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
    AND p.StatusCode != 2)
  GROUP BY step
)
GROUP BY step
ORDER BY failures - recovered DESC, failures DESC, calls DESC
LIMIT 50

label: data-health/fields
sql:
SELECT field, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
ARRAY JOIN ['all', 'model', 'cost', 'user', 'conversation', 'labels', 'outcome'] AS field
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND (field = 'all'
    OR field = 'model' AND notEmpty(Models)
    OR field = 'cost' AND (TotalCost IS NOT NULL OR empty(Models))
    OR field = 'user' AND UserId IS NOT NULL
    OR field = 'conversation' AND ConversationId IS NOT NULL
    OR field = 'labels' AND notEmpty(Labels)
    OR field = 'outcome' AND MetadataOutcome != ''))
GROUP BY field

label: noise/sources
sql:
SELECT multiIf(
    first % 32 > 16, arrayElement(['playground', 'evaluation', 'simulation'], first % 32 - 16),
    environment > 0, arrayElement(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], environment),
    arrayElement(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], first % 32)) AS source,
  count() AS traces,
  sum(cost) AS cost
FROM (
  SELECT trace,
    sum(cost) AS cost,
    any(environment) AS environment,
    minIf(dateDiff('millisecond', toDateTime64(0, 3), at) * 32 + code, isTrace) AS first
  FROM (
    SELECT sipHash128(TraceId) AS trace, Cost AS cost,
      if(DeploymentEnvironment = '', NULL,
        toUInt8(indexOf(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], lower(DeploymentEnvironment)))) AS environment,
      toUInt8(0) AS code, toDateTime64(0, 3) AS at, false AS isTrace
    FROM span_metrics
    WHERE (has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') OR (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE NOT has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1))) AND (span_metrics.TenantId, span_metrics.TraceId) NOT IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE has({dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}, 'application') AND Source NOT IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( StartTime >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartTime < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sipHash128(TraceId) AS trace, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS cost,
      CAST(NULL AS Nullable(UInt8)) AS environment,
      toUInt8(if(has(['playground', 'evaluation', 'simulation'], Origin), 16 + indexOf(['playground', 'evaluation', 'simulation'], Origin),
        indexOf(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], if(has(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], lower(MetadataEnvironment)), lower(MetadataEnvironment),
          arrayFirst((label) -> has(['test', 'testing', 'staging', 'stage', 'dev', 'development', 'qa', 'sandbox', 'local'], label), arrayMap((label) -> lower(label), Labels)))))) AS code,
      OccurredAt AS at, true AS isTrace
    FROM trace_metrics
    WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
  )
  GROUP BY trace
  HAVING countIf(NOT isTrace) > 0 AND first > 0
)
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY traces DESC
LIMIT 20

label: cost-accuracy/trend
sql:
SELECT addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(OccurredAt, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket,
  uniqExactIf(TraceId, notEmpty(Models)) AS with_model,
  uniqExactIf(TraceId, UnpricedSpanCount > 0) AS unpriced
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

label: cost-accuracy/models
sql:
SELECT model, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
ARRAY JOIN UnpricedModels AS model
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY traces DESC
LIMIT 5
